scope: Prepare a later separately approved isolated selection-only diagnostic. It must not run the original worker main, load auth stores, read the private capsule in Node, create a native client, or contact provider services.
actual_input_values: NOT_READ_BY_THIS_REVIEW; no model, workspace, enabled scope or configuration value is invented

original_selection_call.loader: await loader.t({ scope:'all', config:cfg, activationSourceConfig:cfg, workspaceDir:plan.workspace, onlyPluginIds:plan.harnessOwnerPluginIds });

configuration_read_requirements.rule: Preserve the actual captured five-agent declaration/default binding and complete scope; do not infer Codex from provider names, filter Google ordinal 22, or replace agent models. The selected worker call does not supply sessionKey/override.
configuration_read_requirements.public_emission: Only previously admitted fixed agent/plugin identifiers or checked equality booleans; no whole configuration.

configuration_read_requirements.rule: Keep exact presence, type, key order and array order. Direct provider key precedes normalized aliases; exact model precedes wildcard/provider policy. Do not reduce to only the winning-looking entry.
configuration_read_requirements.remaining_dependency: resolveSessionAgentIds/listAgentEntries/normalizers receive config and are imported; this is a proved lower bound, not an exhaustive safe projection.

fields: first normalized OpenAI provider.baseUrl if direct absent
configuration_read_requirements.rule: Missing/blank baseUrl takes the official-default branch; custom or invalid URL can select auto rather than implicit Codex. Removing or replacing it can change selection. Keep the source's exact predicate, not a new URL-security rule.
configuration_read_requirements.sensitivity: A URL may carry credentials. Never publish it or copy an unsafe value into a public/credential-free file. If exact behavior-preserving nonsecret projection is not proven, this input remains blocked.

configuration_read_requirements.rule: The real selector uses support exports i(context) and a(compare), and calls provider ownership for forced and auto branches. The other effective-runtime helper is not a substitute. provider.request and plugin-supplied supports are not assumed credential-free.
configuration_read_requirements.remaining_dependency: providers-y2Lns8fh ownership semantics and each actually registered supports implementation/options are not established by this packet; no automatic reads are proposed for them.

configuration_read_requirements.rule: Do not supply a fabricated manifestRegistry/discovery/installRecords override or a sanitized plugins object and claim equivalence. createApi receives cfg plus schema-validated plugin config; arbitrary plugin config cannot enter public output.
configuration_read_requirements.remaining_dependency: The two proposed implementation sources establish manifest/registration attribution next; config normalization, activation, discovery and module-specific read sets must be accounted for before SDK execution.

fields: original public import prefix and process environment
configuration_read_requirements.rule: Do not introduce QA force variables, inherit credential env, use existing private state roots, or treat a new empty registry as the same as the original worker. Owned diagnostic paths may differ only with an explicit reviewed equivalence boundary. Existing worker imported SDK/order/row/cache before selection; its auth reads must not be reused.

call_order_for_later_bound_diagnostic.action: Before any SDK import, establish and demonstrate the separately reviewed OS sandbox denying all network and nonowned writes, fixed admitted public-code reads and only the owned bounded projection inputs, with complete child/FD ownership. Current package proves no such new execution.

For each original agent scope use the original process-isolation rule, exact declared/default model binding, captured complete harness scope and nonsecret configuration projection with known source consumers. No capsule/auth/cache data is given to Node.

Account for original public module import prefix and global/cache prestate. Preserve the original loader/selector/registry import order; no pre-registration, mocked harness or cache-reset trick to force a result.

Call the original loader.t once with the exact original shape and original full candidate scope. It may reuse a compatible wider active registry; record/check the resulting actual registration set without silently trimming it. loadModules:false and activate:false are not substitutes.

Call selector.o once for the agent with exactly provider/modelId/config/agentId. Do not replace it with resolveEffectiveAgentRuntime or call supports separately to manufacture a result; no factory/native/runAttempt call.

Look up registry.r(selected.id) in that same process and registry. Reuse the original selected.id==='codex' and exact object equality as qualification conditions. A different selector result is an honest nonqualifying observation, not coerced to codex.

Require nonempty real record.ownerPluginId and harness.pluginId and compare both with the actual plugin/manifest owner; registry alone permits divergence. Bind actual registered plugin record root/source and actual executed module entry, manifest and relevant source pins. The two proposed sources must supply provenance before this gate is implementable.

Retain all original loaded/evaluated candidates. In auto mode every registered supports may run; even an unselected plugin can execute during import/registration. Selected-owner restriction never authorizes ignoring those code paths.

Reobserve the same record/object and admitted code/parent identities after the selected call; fail on drift, errors, incomplete report or unknown ownership/closure. This is sequential observation, not atomic custody or live-gateway instance proof.

Emit only fixed typed public booleans, bounded source-derived identifiers/pins and finite priorities needed by the approved schema. Never emit cfg, arbitrary labels/support reasons/error messages, provider requests/URLs, tokens/account data or environment. Close all owned resources and bind real exit/authority.

projection_boundary.existing_private_capsule: 195155-byte previously captured private capsule remains subject to its original identity/hash/parent/FD guards; it is not a Node input and is not read by this work.
projection_boundary.producer: Only a separately approved bounded reader could emit a strict, typed, secret-free owned configuration projection from already captured permitted metadata.
projection_boundary.no_equivalence_shortcut: Preserving the known fields below is necessary but not sufficient: arbitrary imported helpers/register/supports code may inspect other cfg fields. Any required secret-bearing or unreviewed field makes the credential-free proposal incomplete; no placeholder, omission or blanket subtree copy is accepted as equivalent.
projection_boundary.public_output: Never export auth/cache/token/provider-request/URL/environment or arbitrary config/plugin text; current report contains source schemas only.
